in_marathi.name: Kartik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kartik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kartik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kar' meaning 'to do' and 'Tik' meaning 'footprint'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is believed to have left his footprint on earth, marking the beginning of the Dwapara Yuga. Kartik is also the name of Lord Shiva's son, who is revered as the god of knowledge and learning.
